after_landing.notes: Archives the plan folder only when its gaps list has no open entry; with an open gap, skip this step and leave the folder live.

release_levels.reason: Docs only; no behavior of the sync changes.

units.title: The Mac adoption prompt and the Mac tool reference

shared_files.why: human-facing docs outside docs/setup; U1 and U2 report DOCS FALSIFIED lines and never edit them

decisions.decision: Does the plan need a review unit?
decisions.ruling: No. The plan writes docs only; no runnable line changes.
decisions.rejected: A review unit over a docs-only change.

decisions.decision: Can the 16 plans of the merge run in parallel?
decisions.ruling: No. The 16 plans form one linear chain through requires, because most of them edit sync-engine/repo-sync or sync-engine/setup-sync, and parallel plans conflict there. This plan requires 2026-11-04-docs-design-split.

decisions.decision: What does docs/setup/tools.md hold for each tool?
decisions.ruling: From macos/tools/<tool>/tools.toml and macos/packs.toml: the description, the packs that hold it and whether it is a default there, the stage, depends, each file with its mode, template, format, requires and remove keys, the contributions, the [mise.*] sections by name, and the key of each question with a link to its [questions.<key>] table. The question text stays in tools.toml only.
decisions.rejected: Copy the question text into tools.md (two places for one rule).

decisions.decision: Which command does the adoption prompt give for the first run on a new Mac?
decisions.ruling: On a Mac that has mise and the macos-setup clone, the first run passes the variable inline: MACOS_SETUP_CONFIG_PATH=<path of the macos-setup clone> mise run updateall:configs. Later runs get it from the generated mise env. A new Mac uses the parked change of the macos-setup setup script; the doc says so and names the parked step. Each command is one that the landed code supports.
decisions.rejected: Write a command that no landed code supports; leave the first run open with a GAP.

decisions.ruling: An AI agent that works with the owner of the Mac, as docs/sync/index.md does for a repository. Each owner decision is one question at a time. Each step names the command and its pass condition.
decisions.rejected: A how-to for a person only.

decisions.decision: What is the dotfiles.root note of the migration?
decisions.ruling: A personal file stays in dotfiles/ and gets a [mise.dotfiles] entry in macos.toml. The live model sets the mise setting dotfiles.root to the dotfiles/ folder of the macos-setup clone; the guide tells the owner to keep that setting in [mise.settings] of macos.toml when a personal file uses a source path relative to it. The unit checks the [dotfiles] section and dotfiles.root in the mise docs with Context7 before it writes the note.
decisions.rejected: Absolute source paths in every [mise.dotfiles] entry with no note.

decisions.decision: Which names do the Mac docs have?
decisions.ruling: docs/setup/index.md, docs/setup/migrate-dotfiles.md and docs/setup/tools.md. The later "Mac docs" ruling wins over the older placement bullet, which names sync.md and tool-reference.md.

decisions.decision: What does a friend without read access to virajp/macos-setup do in the first step?
decisions.ruling: The friend skips the git merge-base step: the diff of the scratch-HOME comparison is then the list of changes. With access, the agent uses merge-base first.
decisions.rejected: Stop the migration without access to virajp/macos-setup.

decisions.decision: Which command makes the macos-setup repo private?
decisions.ruling: mise x gh@latest -- gh repo edit <owner>/<repo> --visibility private --accept-visibility-change-consequences. It names the repo and runs through mise.
decisions.rejected: gh repo edit without the repo name or outside mise.

decisions.decision: Which heading does a tool section of docs/setup/tools.md have?
decisions.rejected: A level-2 heading, or the tool name without a code span.
